import copy
import math
import unittest

from solution import masked_row_means


class MaskedRowMeansTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_normal_rows_empty_selection_and_numeric_types(self):
        values = [[1, 2.0, 6], [-3, 7, 11.0], [5, 9, 13]]
        mask = [[True, False, True], [False, True, True], [False, False, False]]
        self.assertEqual(masked_row_means(values, mask), (3.5, 9.0, None))

    def test_empty_and_zero_width_shapes(self):
        self.assertEqual(masked_row_means([], []), ())
        self.assertEqual(masked_row_means([[], [], []], [[], [], []]), (None, None, None))

    def test_does_not_mutate_inputs(self):
        values = [[1, 3], [10, 20]]
        mask = [[True, True], [False, True]]
        values_before = copy.deepcopy(values)
        mask_before = copy.deepcopy(mask)
        result = masked_row_means(values, mask)
        self.assertEqual(result, (2.0, 20.0))
        self.assertEqual(values, values_before)
        self.assertEqual(mask, mask_before)
        values[0][0] = 999
        mask[1][1] = False
        self.assertEqual(result, (2.0, 20.0))

    def test_wrong_container_and_element_types_raise_type_error(self):
        cases = [
            (([1, 2],), [[True, False]]),
            ([[1, 2]], ((True, False),)),
            ([1, 2], [[True], [False]]),
            ([[1, 2]], [True]),
            ([[1, True]], [[True, False]]),
            ([[1, "2"]], [[True, False]]),
            ([[1, 2]], [[True, 1]]),
            ([[1, 2]], [[True, None]]),
        ]
        for values, mask in cases:
            with self.subTest(values=values, mask=mask):
                with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
                    masked_row_means(values, mask)

    def test_ragged_or_mismatched_shapes_raise_value_error(self):
        cases = [
            ([[1], [2, 3]], [[True], [True, False]]),
            ([[1], [2]], [[True, False], [True]]),
            ([[1, 2]], [[True]]),
            ([[1]], [[True], [False]]),
            ([], [[]]),
        ]
        for values, mask in cases:
            with self.subTest(values=values, mask=mask):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    masked_row_means(values, mask)

    def test_non_finite_values_raise_value_error(self):
        for bad in [math.nan, math.inf, -math.inf]:
            with self.subTest(bad=bad):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    masked_row_means([[1, bad]], [[True, False]])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
